title: SP Batey Hackathon
text: I took part in the SP Batey Hackathon, which focuses on start-ups created by students. My team, Zenith Technologies, created Frésko, an app that reduces food waste by tracking expiry dates and suggesting recipes for food that is near expiry. This idea secured us a place in the grand finals!
